title: Batman Vol. 1: Failsafe — Convention Exclusive Edition Hardcover DC Comics
descriptionText:
Condition: Very Good — Minor corner ding on front cover (see last photo). Otherwise excellent with tight binding and clean pages.
Description:
Up for sale is the Convention Exclusive Edition of Batman Vol. 1: Failsafe, featuring exclusive wraparound dust jacket art by Jorge Jiménez. This hardcover collects issues #125–130 of the Batman series, written by Chip Zdarsky with artwork by Jorge Jiménez.
A must-have collectible for any Batman or DC Comics fan — this edition showcases stunning art and storytelling that kicks off Zdarsky’s acclaimed run on Batman.
Details:
Publisher: DC Comics
Release Year: 2023
ISBN: 978-1-77950-382-8
Format: Hardcover (Convention Exclusive Edition)
Collects: Batman #125–130
Artists: Jorge Jiménez (cover and interior art)
Writer: Chip Zdarsky
Condition: Very Good — slight corner bump (see photos)
Special Feature: Dual-sided dust jacket featuring alternate cover art
